abstract: An 8-year-old girl complained for 4 months of right arm pain, weakness in both legs, difficulty in arising from a seated or squatting position, and 1 month of pain in her hips, ankles, and knees. On physical examination, she had weak neck flexors, weak proximal and abdominal muscles, and an assisted Gower maneuver; both knees and ankles were painful. Erythematous macules on her elbows, knees, and medial ankles were present without heliotrope rash or dilated eyelid capillaries. She had nail-fold erythema and decreased numbers of nail-fold capillary end-row loops (ERLs) (5.42 ERLs per mm [normal: ≥6.8 ERLs per mm]) without digital ulcers or tight skin. Laboratory testing revealed slightly elevated creatine phosphokinase (440 IU/L [normal: ≤199 IU/L]) and aldolase (11.7 U/L [normal: ≤8.6 U/L]) levels. Her eosinophilia (7.2%) was not characteristic of juvenile dermatomyositis. Rheumatologic evaluation included a positive antinuclear antibody test result (1:5120 titer), speckled pattern (normal: <80 titer), myositis-associated and -specific antibodies that showed indeterminate Mi-2, with the others negative, including p155/140, elevated immunoglobulin G (IgG) (1440 mg/dL [normal range: 608-1229]) and IgE (409 kU/L [normal: <160 kU/L]) levels, and normal levels of IgM and IgA. She had an increased neopterin level (20 nm/L [normal: <10 nm/L]) and decreased absolute count of CD3-CD56/16(+) natural killer cells (89 [lower normal limit: 138]). MRI of her thigh muscles revealed serpiginous increased T-2 signals consistent with inflammation and a complex round mass in the left pelvis. A muscle biopsy did not indicate juvenile dermatomyositis. Pelvic ultrasound confirmed a solid mass of the left ovary consistent with a mature teratoma. After surgical removal of the teratoma, the myositis, synovitis, and cutaneous findings resolved over 4 months without further therapy.
abstract_ja: 8歳の女児が4か月間、右腕の痛み、両脚の筋力低下、立ち上がりの困難を訴えた。さらに1か月前から股関節、足首、膝の痛みも加わった。身体診察では首の屈筋、近位筋、腹筋の筋力低下、補助を要するゴワーズ徴候、両膝と足首の疼痛、肘・膝・内果の紅斑性皮疹、爪郭部の紅斑、爪郭毛細血管の終末ループ数の減少（5.42 ERL/mm、正常6.8以上）を認めた。ヘリオトロープ疹や眼瞼の拡張毛細血管はなく、デジタル潰瘍や皮膚硬化もなかった。検査では、クレアチンホスホキナーゼ（440 IU/L、正常199以下）とアルドラーゼ（11.7 U/L、正常8.6以下）がわずかに上昇した。好酸球増多（7.2%）は若年性皮膚筋炎に特徴的ではなかった。リウマチ検査では抗核抗体陽性（1:5120、斑紋型）、筋炎関連・特異的抗体はMi-2が判定保留、p155/140を含む他は陰性であった。IgG（1440 mg/dL、正常608～1229）とIgE（409 kU/L、正常160未満）が上昇し、IgMとIgAは正常であった。ネオプテリンが上昇（20 nm/L、正常10未満）し、CD3-CD56/16陽性ナチュラルキラー細胞の絶対数が減少（89、下限138）していた。大腿筋の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では炎症を示す蛇行状のT2高信号と、左骨盤内の複雑な円形腫瘤を認めた。筋生検では若年性皮膚筋炎は否定された。骨盤超音波検査で左卵巣の充実性腫瘤を確認し、成熟奇形腫と合致した。奇形腫の摘除後、筋炎、滑膜炎、皮膚所見は追加治療なしに4か月かけて軽快した。
